units.source_text: 你总得对我说一句可怜的话呀！

en.t: You must at least say one compassionate word to me!

units.source_text: 让我的心安静下来，使我失迷在自己所造成的暗路上，也可看到一线光明。”

en.t: Let my heart grow calm, so that even on the dark road of my own making, where I have lost my way, I may see a single ray of light.”

units.source_text: 对于小侍从，他也毫无顾忌地写了一封缠绵悱恻的信去，

en.t: He also wrote to Kojiju without the slightest restraint, sending her a deeply plaintive and passionate letter,

units.source_text: 要求她再来与他会面一次。

en.t: asking her to come and meet him once more.

units.source_text: 小侍从的姨母是柏木的乳母，因此自幼常在他家进出，和柏木一向熟识。

en.t: Kojiju's aunt was Kashiwagi's wet nurse, so from childhood she had often gone in and out of his house and had always known Kashiwagi well.

units.source_text: 虽然为了此次不法之事而痛恨他，但闻知他即将命终，也不胜悲伤，

en.t: Although she hated him for this unlawful affair, when she heard that he was about to die, she could not help grieving,

units.source_text: 啼啼哭哭地对三公主说：“这封信公主总得答复，这真是最后一次了。”

en.t: and, weeping bitterly, said to the Third Princess, “My lady, you really must answer this letter; this is truly the last time.”

units.source_text: 三公主答道：“我也命在旦夕了！

en.t: The Third Princess answered, “My own life is hanging by a thread!
It is certainly pitiful when someone is about to die,

units.source_text: 但我已是惊弓之鸟，不敢再做这种事情了。”

en.t: but I am already like a bird startled by the bowstring, and I dare not do such a thing again.”
She absolutely refused to write a reply.

units.source_text: 这并非她主意坚定之故，

en.t: This was not because her resolve was firm,

units.source_text: 恐是她所羞见的那个人脸色常常难看，使她十分害怕耳。

en.t: but probably because the person she was ashamed to face often wore such a grim expression that it frightened her terribly.

units.source_text: 然而小侍从已经准备笔砚，定要她写，她只得勉勉强强地写了。

en.t: Yet Kojiju had already prepared brush and inkstone and insisted that she write, so she had no choice but to do it reluctantly.

units.source_text: 小侍从就拿了信，趁夜间无人注目之时，悄悄地走进柏木邸内。

en.t: Kojiju then took the letter and, when no one was watching at night, slipped quietly into Kashiwagi's residence.
